hero.title: Bring in records from other tools
hero.subtitle: AI summaries · test results · notes
hero.speech: Pasted material is sorted first, then saved only when you confirm.

promptCard.title: Ask another AI to summarize what it knows about you
promptCard.description: If you've talked about yourself with another AI, paste these questions there. Then copy its reply back here.
promptCard.copyHint: Copies the import questions to the clipboard.

pasteCard.title: Reply or test result
pasteCard.description: Paste an AI reply, a past personality test result or notes about yourself. 2nd-Brain will sort the content and add tags.
pasteCard.sortHint: Sorts the pasted material before saving.

toast.promptPlaced: The questions were placed below. Long-press to copy them.
toast.saveFailed: Couldn't save it. The sorted result is still here; please try again.
toast.storagePending: Your text was saved, but the backup file didn't upload.

result.title: Imported record
result.degraded: Detailed sorting isn't available right now. Your content has been sorted using basic rules on this device. Try again later.
result.keepHint: Saves this imported result to your records.

saved.title: Saved
saved.body: Your summary and SecondB's answers can use these records.
saved.moreHint: Clears this import and starts another one.
